gloss_en: "the city of blood" (ir ha-damim) — the biblical epithet for a bloodstained city (Ezekiel 22:2; Nahum 3:1), invoked as the aspect of impure blood/menstrual defilement caused to the Shekhinah by blemish of the covenant; from עִיר (city) + דָּמִים (bloods), not to be confused with עֵר (awake) or דָּמִים as money
